["Mix flour, salt, and sugar. Using a processor, a pastry blender, or your fingertips, cut the salted butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles cornmeal. Add unsalted butter and shortening and cut them in until the lumps are the size of peas.","If using a processor, transfer the mixture to a large bowl.
